map.P/E = 股价 / 每股收益: P/E = share price / earnings per share
map.股价相对于盈利的估值倍数。: The valuation multiple of the share price relative to earnings.
map.倍数越高估值越贵。: The higher the multiple, the more expensive the valuation.
map.看股价相对盈利的贵贱。: See whether the price is cheap or expensive relative to earnings.
map.用每股市价除以每股收益，快速判断估值贵贱。: Divide the market price per share by earnings per share to quickly judge whether the valuation is cheap or expensive.
map.P/E = 60/3 = 20 倍。即按当前盈利需 20 年回本（未折现）。: P/E = 60/3 = 20x. That is, at current earnings it takes 20 years to recover the cost (undiscounted).
map.股价 45 元、每股收益 EPS 3 元: Share price 45 CNY, earnings per share EPS 3 CNY
map.PE=45/3=15.00 倍，含义是按当前盈利水平静态推算，约需 15 年的利: PE=45/3=15.00x, meaning that on a static projection of current earnings it takes about 15 years of total profit to recover the cost (without counting earnings growth).
map.P/E 低一定便宜？: Is a low P/E always cheap?
map.低 P/E 可能盈利将下滑或周期顶部；高 P/E 可能高成长。要结合增速(EPE: A low P/E may mean earnings are about to fall or a cyclical peak; a high P/E may mean high growth. Judge it together with growth (PEG) and quality.
map.PE 为负是什么意思？: What does a negative P/E mean?
map.公司亏损时 EPS 为负，PE 也随之变负并失去估值参考价值，此时可改用市销率: When a company is loss-making, EPS is negative and the P/E also turns negative and loses valuation reference value; in that case use the price-to-sales ratio PS or the
map.PB。周期股在盈利低谷时 PE 还会虚高，是典型的估值陷阱。: PB instead. Cyclical stocks also show an inflated P/E at the earnings trough, a classic valuation trap.
